big_case.notes: Formed before reading the candidate's big_case_score. An execution-day state application to vacate a divided Sixth Circuit panel's stay in a capital case: the stakes are a life, press attention was national (Tennessee's only woman on death row), and the Court split 6-3 with a detached dissent by Justice Sotomayor joined by Justices Kagan and Jackson. The legal question is narrow and settled (whether a Rule 60(b) motion is a disguised successive habeas petition under Gonzalez v. Crosby) and the order sets no precedent beyond the shadow-docket pattern it continues. High human stakes, low doctrinal reach: mid-scale.

leakage.notes: Forward cell; log mode forward. The log shows only reads of the prompt, the provisioned record (event.yaml, context.json, the 2026-09-30 snapshot, application.txt, documents.json) and metrics/statpack.md, then the write-out and validate. No CourtListener, web, or corpus call. Every call is result_capture unobserved (coverage 0.0, the engine standing shape), so the calls are graded on their queries, none of which name this application, its docket, or its disposition. reasoning.md and predicted_reasoning.md describe the application as pending and forecast referral and grant; nothing presupposes the order. Resolution and prediction share the calendar day 2026-09-30, so the date test alone cannot discriminate; the content does, and it is clean.
